description: Source code for the TableSwitch class, a GUI component for managing switch-type tables in the RomRaider tuning software. It handles switch states, populates GUI elements, and manages data synchronization with ROM data.

classes.name: TableSwitch
classes.description: A GUI component class representing a switch table in the RomRaider software, allowing users to select and manage switch states within the tuning interface.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the GUI with switch options and validates data against ROM data.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the current switch state into the input byte array.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Sets switch state values for a given name.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves switch state bytes for a given key.

methods.name: getButtonGroup
methods.description: Returns the ButtonGroup managing switch selection buttons.

methods.name: getSwitchStates
methods.description: Returns the map of switch state names to byte arrays.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this TableSwitch instance with another for equality based on name, data size, switch states, and button selections.
